messages:
maria: Quick sync — cutover for runtime-3.6 today 21:00 UTC. Propose a 20:30 dry-run for smoke + rollback verification. Owners I have in mind: @sanjeev (canary lane), @evelyn (smoke validation), @kevin (rollback lead). Can each owner confirm availability? Also need a quick creds check with @people-ops for the KMS/HSM step.

sanjeev: I can own the canary lane. Will warm up nodes and run perf smoke at 20:30. Plan: start with 1% traffic, run latency p95 check, then signal. ETA ~15m.

evelyn: I’ll run the smoke suite and the end-to-end prompt checks. 1% sounds good — will run the regression tests in parallel. Need the new model hash for the golden prompt set?

maria: use model hash a1b2c3 (latest build). Checklist I want us to follow during the dry-run — please copy/paste and confirm each item when done:
```
[ ] Canary lanes warmed and green (sanjeev)
[ ] Smoke tests passed for golden prompts (evelyn)
[ ] KV cache correctness validation (evelyn)
[ ] Autoscaler sanity (observe no flapping) (sanjeev)
[ ] Rollback toggled in staging and verified (kevin)
[ ] KMS/HSM key access tested (people-ops)
[ ] Observe metrics for token cost spike, errors, latency (maria)
```

kevin: Rollback runbook is on the ops repo (ops/runbooks/runtime-cutover.md). I will perform a rollback dry-run: flip the feature-flag, ensure traffic drains, and validate fallback model returns expected outputs. One ask: I need temporary IAM elevation to run the toggle in prod-sentinel for the dry-run — @people-ops can you pre-approve 30m?

people-ops: Can grant a 30-minute elevation starting 20:25 if everyone confirms. We’ll need the list of principals (sanjeev, kevin) and justification. Reply here with the list and I’ll issue the elevation.

maria: Principals: sanjeev, kevin. Justification: rollback dry-run for runtime-3.6 cutover. Please approve by 20:15 so we don’t block.

kevin: ack, I’ll add my public key to the runbook and post a short note when I’ve verified the toggle sequence.

sanjeev: Quick note on metrics — I’ll export a short perf snapshot and post a link to the dashboard in this thread. Also will run the kv-cache check:
```bash
# quick kv validation
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/kv-check -d '{"model":"a1b2c3","seed":42}'
```

maria: perfect. Deploy-bot scheduled the window: deploy-bot: "deploy window reserved 21:00-21:30 UTC, owners: maria/sanjeev/evelyn/kevin".

oncall-bot: "monitoring alert rules engaged: latency-p95, error-rate > 1%, token-cost-surge. Pager rotation: oncall-team-1"

kevin: I’ll run the rollback dry-run at 20:30 after sanjeev signals canary stable. Please shout if any step fails — we revert the flag and abort cutover.

evelyn: Confirmed — I’ll post smoke results here. If any golden prompts regress by >1% fidelity, we abort.

maria: final asks before we close this thread: everyone reply with a one-line ack when you have the elevation and your lane is green. I’ll be in the #launch-ops voice channel at 20:20 in case we need live coordination. :headphones:

sanjeev: ack — lane green, will post dashboard link by 20:28. :thumbsup:

evelyn: ack — smoke suite ready, running at 20:30.

people-ops: elevation granted to sanjeev, kevin from 20:25-20:55 UTC. Logged request id: ELEV-20260317-77.

kevin: ack, elevation received and tested. Rollback dry-run complete in staging, toggle sequence validated.

maria: thanks all — proceeding with dry-run as planned. I’ll post a short summary and next steps after 20:35.

sanjeev: dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/runtime-cutover?view=canary-20-30 (perf snapshots + logs)

evelyn: smoke results: all golden prompts passed, small latency bump +5ms p95, no error increase. :white_check_mark:

maria: excellent. All green — we’ll proceed to the 21:00 cutover unless any new blockers appear. :rocket:
